clue.text: Staff needing energy and a lot of skill that’ll be raised for hunting

indicators.note: needing here means lacking, so the staff word goes without the energy symbol
a lot of something is most but not all of it, so the skill word loses its last letter

blocks.note: a mace is a ceremonial staff
E is the physics symbol for energy
a hand is a skill, as in having a good hand at something

explanation.surface: A hunter's staff needs energy and plenty of skill to be lifted on the hunt.
explanation.walkthrough: MACE loses its E and HAND loses its D, giving MAC + HAN = MACHAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A machan is a platform built up in a tree in India, from which tigers and other game are shot.

as a noun, an exquisite is a dandy, a fop
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: In 2022 a newspaper livestreamed a lettuce to see whether it would outlast Prime Minister Liz Truss, which it did; here Truss is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A megaflop is an enormous failure, mega- meaning huge and a flop being something that fails badly.

explanation.definitionFit: Chana is the Indian name for chickpeas, also called Bengal gram, a gram being any of several edible pulses.
